parity_drift_banner: Apply drift: the gateway may not reflect the saved policy. Check /health and re-apply.
devices_empty: No policy entries - every device follows the default rules.
audit_empty: No audit entries yet - policy changes will appear here.
audit_stale: Refresh failed - showing the last successful load.
audit_paused: Auto-refresh paused while viewing older entries.
token_prompt: Enter the panel token (PANEL_SECRET) to make changes. It is stored only in this browser.
band_confirm: This device is pinned by the router-side FULL_PROXY_SOURCES band. A dynamic policy outranks the band on the gateway - apply the override anyway?
purge_confirm: Delete ALL collected statistics (domains included)? The policy audit is not touched.
error_generic: The request was rejected - see the message.
delete_drift_warn: The entry was removed from the store, but the gateway apply FAILED - the device policy may still be live on the gateway. Check the drift banner and re-apply.
band_confirm_unknown: Could not check the router band list. This address MIGHT be a router-pinned band member - apply the override anyway?
stats_empty: No traffic recorded in this range.
stats_unreachable: The panel is unreachable - this is the last successful load.
framings_note: The definition of a day changed inside this window (zone / start time)
coverage_truncated: the range asked for starts before the oldest data held, so this covers less than requested
alias_write_failed: The device was added but its name was not saved - use Rename to retry.
settings_unchanged: Nothing changed - the values sent were already in force.
aliases_help: An alias is the identity-layer name: it survives the device's policy being removed, and a name you type outranks every importer.
stats_unavailable: The stats store did not answer - this is not a statement about your traffic.
history_failed: Could not read this device's history - an empty chart would have looked like no traffic.
chart_aria: Traffic over time. Use the arrow keys to read each bucket.
chart_stale_since: Stale - the collector has not updated it since
chart_unavailable: The stats store did not answer - nothing is drawn, because an empty chart would claim no traffic.
chart_unreachable: The panel is unreachable - nothing is drawn.
chart_empty: No traffic recorded in this window.
chart_gap: Collection gap - no data, not zero
chart_gap_partial: Part of this bucket fell in a collection gap
share_title: What the traffic could be attributed to
list_unrecorded: Traffic this list has no record of
chart_shade: Older than the hostname window: hostnames, app-level ids and the attribution split are not kept here; bytes, exit nodes, countries and categories still are
chart_empty_category: No bytes were recorded under this category in this window.
domains_optin: To keep hostnames for 7 days, set PANEL_STATS_DOMAINS=true in .env and redeploy (see INSIGHTS.txt).
hint_gateway_only: Only traffic that passes through the gateway is counted. A device or a DNS path that bypasses it - an IPv6 route the router hands out, a DNS server outside the gateway - is not seen here.
unavail_scoped_device: this view is one device already
unavail_scoped_self: this view is that value already
unavail_independent: the stats store keeps each dimension separately, so this list cannot be cut by this scope
unavail_domains_off: hostnames are not kept (PANEL_STATS_DOMAINS is off)
unavail_coverage: it is measured for the whole gateway only
chart_shade_host: Older than the hostname window: this hostname's traffic is not kept here - no bar means no data, not no traffic
live_not_stored: Live only - nothing from it is stored.
live_full: The panel has too many live viewers right now. Turn this off and on later to try again.
live_closed: The live feed closed. Turn this off and on to try again.
delay_aria: Delay of the selected node over time. Use the arrow keys to read each test.
delay_failed_legend: No answer (a failed test, not 0 ms)
delay_empty: No delay test is stored yet - mihomo's tests are sampled every 5 minutes.
delay_unavailable: The node delay could not be read.
quota_pending: Not sampled yet - the quota is sampled once an hour.
quota_off: The collector is not running, so the quota is not sampled.
quota_unavailable: The quota could not be read.
quota_error: mihomo did not answer the newest sample.
live_hole: No figures - the stream was quiet, not zero
